title: Rizia/Turn 10/STRIKE SCENE/ABSOLUTIST STRIKE SCENE/House Azaro Strike/House Azaro Strike Conversation

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I will not yield, not when I've fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not yield, not when I've fought to keep this realm whole. I refuse to sign away my family’s legacy."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: "“Father, please. Think of the famil..."
entries.dialogueText: “Father, please. Think of the family. Pride isn't worth the cost.”

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""It’s not what any of us want, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s not what any of us want, but there is no point in resisting the Crown."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus’s jaw clenched, his eyes bl..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus’s jaw clenched, his eyes blazing with defiance.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""No. Never. I’d sooner die.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Never. I’d sooner die."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus. Shoot him.""
entries.dialogueText: "Titus. Shoot him."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without hesitating, Titus raised hi..."
entries.dialogueText: Without hesitating, Titus raised his gun and fired, a single shot resonating throughout the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus’ body tumbled out of his wh..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus’ body tumbled out of his wheelchair and crumpled lifelessly to the floor, blood pooling around him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's scream pierced the room."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's scream pierced the room.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You… BASTARD!""
entries.dialogueText: "You… BASTARD!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Anyone else feeling brave?""
entries.dialogueText: "Anyone else feeling brave?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita glared at me, her gaze a mix..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita glared at me, her gaze a mix of rage and anguish, readying to lash out. But Carlos grabbed her arm, pulling her back.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Don’t. Think of what will happen i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don’t. Think of what will happen if we refuse. This is the only way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a moment, Lucita took a deep..."
entries.dialogueText: After a moment, Lucita took a deep breath and stepped toward the table. She turned and looked at me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She picked up the pen with tremblin..."
entries.dialogueText: She picked up the pen with trembling fingers and bent down as though to sign the document.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But then, in a flash, her hand move..."
entries.dialogueText: But then, in a flash, her hand moved to her side, pulled out the hidden knife she always carried, and drew her arm back.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus reacted instantly, piercing t..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus reacted instantly, piercing the air with another gunshot.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita staggered back, clutching he..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita staggered back, clutching her thigh as she fell to her knees, her face a mask of pain and defiance.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: "“You’ll never get away with this!”"
entries.dialogueText: “You’ll never get away with this!”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Arrest her -- *immediately*.""
entries.dialogueText: "Arrest her -- *immediately*."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, sir."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus, see to it that she meets th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus, see to it that she meets the same fate as her father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In one swift motion, Titus aimed an..."
entries.dialogueText: In one swift motion, Titus aimed and pulled the trigger. Lucita collapsed, lifeless, beside her father.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos's face blanched with fear. H..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos's face blanched with fear. He glanced at the blood on the floor, his lips trembling.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I... I swear my undying allegiance..."
entries.dialogueText: "I... I swear my undying allegiance to you, Your Majesty. I’ll do as you ask."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He picked up the pen from the floor..."
entries.dialogueText: He picked up the pen from the floor, kneeling to sign the document with shaking hands.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There. That wasn't so difficult, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "There. That wasn't so difficult, was it?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The smell of smoke and gunpowder hu..."
entries.dialogueText: The smell of smoke and gunpowder hung in the room, marking the final moment of House Azaro’s defiance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus took hold of Taddeus's wheelc..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus took hold of Taddeus's wheelchair, passing him off to the other guardsmen waiting at the far end of the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your fate was sealed the moment yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your fate was sealed the moment you crossed me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I sense hostility -- not a good po..."
entries.dialogueText: "I sense hostility -- not a good position for negotiations, though there’s nothing to negotiate."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: "“Please, Father. Think of the famil..."
entries.dialogueText: “Please, Father. Think of the family. Pride isn't worth the cost.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now... Your signature, if you will.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now... Your signature, if you will."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It’s not what any of us want, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s not what any of us want, but this is our only chance.”

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Taddeus, for the sake of the famil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Taddeus, for the sake of the family, you must reconsider. Our pride is not worth the cost.”

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You will not escape the consequenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will not escape the consequences of this action! Mark my words... justice will be served!"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He can’t force us into anything, F..."
entries.dialogueText: "He can’t force us into anything, Father. His Majesty fathered a child with me. House Azaro's fate is bound with the Crown's."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Are you two mad? I don't like this..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you two mad? I don't like this anymore than you do, but what choice do we have?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He can’t force us into anything, F..."
entries.dialogueText: "He can’t force us into anything, Father. Our legacy isn't theirs to claim."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Under the authority vested in me a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Under the authority vested in me as king, I place you under arrest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Justice is precisely what’s being..."
entries.dialogueText: "Justice is precisely what’s being served."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus! His hands appear to be too..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus! His hands appear to be too weak. Please help him with the signature."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am grateful for your commitment...."
entries.dialogueText: "I am grateful for your commitment. Rise, for your actions do not go unnoticed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One act does not prove your loyalt..."
entries.dialogueText: "One act does not prove your loyalty. I expect to see consistency in your actions from here on out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you sure you’re not trying to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure you’re not trying to sign in Morse code? I can barely read that mess!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Justice lies in the hands of those..."
entries.dialogueText: "Justice lies in the hands of those who hold power, not in empty ideals."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Justice is mine to command. Your a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Justice is mine to command. Your actions left me no choice."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Yes, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Nothing you could say or do could..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing you could say or do could convince me otherwise."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""It’s not what any of us want, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s not what any of us want, but there is no point in resisting."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I’d sooner die than give an inch!""
entries.dialogueText: "I’d sooner die than give an inch!"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Your Majesty, my allegiance is to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, my allegiance is to you and you alone. The rest of House Azaro is at your command."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Jaw clenched, Taddeus’s eyes blazin..."
entries.dialogueText: Jaw clenched, Taddeus’s eyes blazing with defiance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's scream pierced the room as..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's scream pierced the room as the sound of fear filled the air.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos sat paralyzed, eyes wide in..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos sat paralyzed, eyes wide in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And then there was one.""
entries.dialogueText: "And then there was one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well? What will it be, Carlos?""
entries.dialogueText: "Well? What will it be, Carlos?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Thank you, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, sir."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I pledge my loyalty to you. The re..."
entries.dialogueText: "I pledge my loyalty to you. The rest of House Azaro is at your command."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Please, spare me, Your Majesty. My..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, spare me, Your Majesty. My allegiance is to you and you alone. The rest of House Azaro is at your command."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""These documents aren't going to si..."
entries.dialogueText: "These documents aren't going to sign themselves, General."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Please, spare me, Your Majesty. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, spare me, Your Majesty. I pledge my loyalty to you. The rest of House Azaro is at your command."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos took a moment to steady hims..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos took a moment to steady himself before completing his signature and stepping away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos rose slowly, his head bowed..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos rose slowly, his head bowed in quiet acknowledgment as he stepped away.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'll give you your damn signature...."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll give you your damn signature. But if you think that will buy my silence, you don’t know me at all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita pressed the pen to the page,..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita pressed the pen to the page, her strokes sharp and deliberate,

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There. Was that so hard?""
entries.dialogueText: "There. Was that so hard?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Such defiance. I’ll give you credi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such defiance. I’ll give you credit for that, though I wonder how far it will take you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, Lucita, silence from you was n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, Lucita, silence from you was never my expectation. Guards, take her into custody immediately."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Not nearly as hard as it’ll be for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not nearly as hard as it’ll be for you when I’m through."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Farther than you think. I don’t re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Farther than you think. I don’t rely on credit from men like you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Uneasy whispers filled the room as..."
entries.dialogueText: Uneasy whispers filled the room as eyes darted nervously, marking the final moment of House Azaro’s defiance.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Let it be known that House Azaro w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let it be known that House Azaro will never respect the legitimacy of this fraudulent document."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I’m sure I'll lose sleep over it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I’m sure I'll lose sleep over it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just try to challenge it. You'll s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just try to challenge it. You'll see how much weight this document carries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alright. That was the last straw,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alright. That was the last straw, General."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry, love. But it has to be done.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, love. But it has to be done."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Romus, how could you?!""
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, how could you?!"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""There's nothing you can say or do..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's nothing you can say or do that would make me betray my family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your duty is to me, not to a crumb..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your duty is to me, not to a crumbling legacy."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If loyalty to my own blood is a cr..."
entries.dialogueText: "If loyalty to my own blood is a crime, then so be it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I am not afraid of you, and I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not afraid of you, and I will not betray my family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After everything we've shared, you..."
entries.dialogueText: "After everything we've shared, you would still choose them over me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I AM your family -- WE are a famil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I AM your family -- WE are a family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not afraid? You should be. Titus,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not afraid? You should be. Titus, see to her arrest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then you have forced my hand. Titu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then you have forced my hand. Titus, please help her with the signature."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your defiance only serves to endan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your defiance only serves to endanger our child. You shall be taken into custody immediately."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Without question.""
entries.dialogueText: "Without question."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Just because we share a child does..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just because we share a child doesn't mean I will follow you blindly into treachery."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She placed a hand on her pregnant b..."
entries.dialogueText: She placed a hand on her pregnant belly.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I swear my undying allegiance to y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear my undying allegiance to you, Your Majesty. I’ll do as you ask."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty, I've given my blood,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I've given my blood, my years, and my loyalty to Rizia -- to preserve the very kingdom you now accuse me of betraying."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I have sacrificed more than most,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have sacrificed more than most, and yet you demand that I surrender the very legacy I've fought to protect."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus' expression twisted in ange..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus' expression twisted in anger.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You fool! She's with child!""
entries.dialogueText: "You fool! She's with child!"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm sorry, Your Majesty. But your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Your Majesty. But your life was in danger."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You'll pay for that little stunt.""
entries.dialogueText: "You'll pay for that little stunt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After everything we've been throug..."
entries.dialogueText: "After everything we've been through, this is how you choose to repay me?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Believe me, my repayment is far fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Believe me, my repayment is far from finished!"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""How could you?! I'm carrying your..."
entries.dialogueText: "How could you?! I'm carrying your child!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Arrest her. See to it that she is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Arrest her. See to it that she is given the necessary medical attention. If she's to be brought to justice, I need her alive."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Alright. Let's get her out of here.""
entries.dialogueText: "Alright. Let's get her out of here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Upon Titus' command, several men in..."
entries.dialogueText: Upon Titus' command, several men in uniform carefully escorted her to the other side of the room, where her wound was quickly attended to.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“Gladly.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Gladly.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus stepped forward swiftly, grip..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus stepped forward swiftly, gripping her arms firmly as he pulled her back, then handed her off to his guardsmen who thwarted her attempts to resist.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, 'think.' But not too long. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, 'think.' But not too long. I don't have all day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd heed Carlos' warning if I were..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd heed Carlos' warning if I were you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without missing a beat, two men pus..."
entries.dialogueText: Without missing a beat, two men pushed Taddeus' wheelchair to the desk and pressed a pen firmly into his grip.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Despite Taddeus' attempt to resist,..."
entries.dialogueText: Despite Taddeus' attempt to resist, the men wrenched his hand to the signature line, forcing him to write his name, though it was barely legible.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, don't get all weepy on me now...."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, don't get all weepy on me now. He got what he deserved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By Divine authority.""
entries.dialogueText: "By Divine authority."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With charm and persistence, my dea..."
entries.dialogueText: "With charm and persistence, my dear."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You've crossed a line today, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've crossed a line today, Your Majesty. This is a betrayal beyond measure."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your actions are no better than th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your actions are no better than the whims of a despot."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I was wrong about you. Your action..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was wrong about you. Your actions are no better than the whims of a despot."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""'Divine authority?'""
entries.dialogueText: "'Divine authority?'"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita scoffed."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita scoffed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You know, I was wrong about you. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know, I was wrong about you. Beneath it all, you're just another despot."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You always have a choice, Romus. D..."
entries.dialogueText: "You always have a choice, Romus. Don’t hide behind excuses."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It had to be done.""
entries.dialogueText: "It had to be done."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You didn't *have* to do anything!..."
entries.dialogueText: "You didn't *have* to do anything! You always have a choice. Don’t hide behind excuses."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Protest all you like. I'll make a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Protest all you like. I'll make a note of it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita scowled."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita scowled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That may be the first honest thing..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be the first honest thing you've ever said to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Better a despot than a coward who..."
entries.dialogueText: "Better a despot than a coward who stands idle in the face of crisis."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're pretty when you're angry.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're pretty when you're angry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may soon regret those words.""
entries.dialogueText: "You may soon regret those words."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned my attention toward Carlos..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned my attention toward Carlos.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Anything you'd like to add?""
entries.dialogueText: "Anything you'd like to add?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you've got anything to say, now..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you've got anything to say, now's the time, General."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are you looking at?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you looking at?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Only that I swear my undying loyal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only that I swear my undying loyalty to you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""King and country come before all e..."
entries.dialogueText: "King and country come before all else."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's self-evident. Nevertheless,..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's self-evident. Nevertheless, I accept your pledge of devotion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good man. I knew I could count on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good man. I knew I could count on you to see reason."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How swiftly you shift loyalties. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "How swiftly you shift loyalties. But loyalty is loyalty, no matter where it lands."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's eyes flared with fury."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's eyes flared with fury.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos bowed his head respectfully."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos bowed his head respectfully.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Traitor!""
entries.dialogueText: "Traitor!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""More like the pot calling the kett..."
entries.dialogueText: "More like the pot calling the kettle black."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I think 'patriot' is the word you'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think 'patriot' is the word you're looking for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I rolled my eyes, ignoring her comm..."
entries.dialogueText: I rolled my eyes, ignoring her commentary.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I’ll never forget the searing hatre..."
entries.dialogueText: I’ll never forget the searing hatred that burned in her eyes as she looked at me.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Nothing, Your Majesty. I only wish..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing, Your Majesty. I only wish to convey my undying loyalty to you."

entries.dialogueText: Carlos sat paralyzed, his expression frozen in disbelief, as the sound of fear filled the air.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Carlos sat paralyzed, his expression frozen in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's scream pierced the room."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's scream pierced the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An eerie silence marked the final m..."
entries.dialogueText: An eerie silence marked the final moment of House Azaro’s defiance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos bowed his head in quiet ackn..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos bowed his head in quiet acknowledgment as he stepped away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The general took a knee and bowed h..."
entries.dialogueText: The general took a knee and bowed his head.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am grateful for your commitment...."
entries.dialogueText: "I am grateful for your commitment. Rise."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. Time will tell if your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Time will tell if your words match your actions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll see how long that lasts. Jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll see how long that lasts. Just don’t make me regret it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I’m glad to hear it. Your loyalty..."
entries.dialogueText: "I’m glad to hear it. Your loyalty means more than you realize."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The silence fell heavy, marking the..."
entries.dialogueText: The silence fell heavy, marking the final moment of House Azaro’s defiance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita glared at me, her gaze a mix..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita glared at me, her gaze a mix of rage and anguish, readying to lash out.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't try anything funny. You know..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't try anything funny. You know what you have to do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you know what's good for you, y..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you know what's good for you, you'll sign."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough of this. Your father’s gone..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough of this. Your father’s gone. Sign it now, or I’ll make you regret not doing so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stand down, Lucita. You're testing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stand down, Lucita. You're testing my patience."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Patience be damned!""
entries.dialogueText: "Patience be damned!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Don't be a fool, Taddeus. You know..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be a fool, Taddeus. You know there's only one choice to make here."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Carlos is right. You may not like..."
entries.dialogueText: "Carlos is right. You may not like it, but you're not blind -- this is the only option you have left."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Don't be a fool, General. You know..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be a fool, General. You know there's only one choice to make here."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Pity it had to come to this.""
entries.dialogueText: "Pity it had to come to this."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Farewell, Duchess.""
entries.dialogueText: "Farewell, Duchess."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo’s gaze lingered on Lucita's bo..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo’s gaze lingered on Lucita's body, as if struggling to process what had happened.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty... I must admit, I ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... I must admit, I never thought you'd take it this far."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo stepped near me, leaning in to..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo stepped near me, leaning in to whisper.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps you underestimated my reso..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps you underestimated my resolve, Uncle. A mistake, I trust, you won't make again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you lack the stomach for hard d..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you lack the stomach for hard decisions, perhaps it’s best you remain silent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may not see it now, but this w..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may not see it now, but this will secure the future of the kingdom, Hugo."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""For all our sakes, I hope you're r..."
entries.dialogueText: "For all our sakes, I hope you're right."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""No, Your Majesty. Your resolve is..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, Your Majesty. Your resolve is clearer than ever."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo lowered his gaze, offering no..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo lowered his gaze, offering no reply.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Dear God...""
entries.dialogueText: "Dear God..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Well, that was less troublesome th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, that was less troublesome than I anticipated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sometimes things fall into place w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sometimes things fall into place when you have the proper leverage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I’m sure it was, Uncle. But let’s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I’m sure it was, Uncle. But let’s not get ahead of ourselves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A reminder that the simplest appro..."
entries.dialogueText: "A reminder that the simplest approach can often be the most effective."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""True enough, Your Majesty. Leverag..."
entries.dialogueText: "True enough, Your Majesty. Leverage is everything."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""No! Stop! What are you doing?!""
entries.dialogueText: "No! Stop! What are you doing?!"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Let go of me! You have no idea wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let go of me! You have no idea what you've done! This betrayal will haunt you!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her screams continued to echo as sh..."
entries.dialogueText: Her screams continued to echo as she was dragged out of the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to Carlos."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to Carlos.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So be it.""
entries.dialogueText: "So be it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus looked at me for a signal."
entries.dialogueText: Titus looked at me for a signal.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Arrest him immediately.""
entries.dialogueText: "Arrest him immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured at Titus to pass the pen..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured at Titus to pass the pen.
entries.menuText: Gesture at Titus to pass the pen.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Don’t. Think of what will happen i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don’t. Think of what will happen if you refuse. This is the only way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita glared at me, her gaze a mix..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita glared at me, her gaze a mix of rage and anguish, readying to lash out. Hugo grabbed her arm, pulling her back.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd heed my uncle's warning if I w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd heed my uncle's warning if I were you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I watched her in silence."
entries.dialogueText: I watched her in silence.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Narrator: "Carlos's face blanched with fear. H..."]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It took less than a heartbeat to re..."
entries.dialogueText: It took less than a heartbeat to realize that I was her intended target.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""NO!""
entries.dialogueText: "NO!"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Damn you, Romus Toras. You are a t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Damn you, Romus Toras. You are a traitor to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't let you go after you told..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't let you go after you told me that now, can I?"

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Player_Romus: ""Under the authority vested in me a..."]

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Nor House Sazon for that matter.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nor House Sazon for that matter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It makes my eyes tear up to see Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "It makes my eyes tear up to see Housea Sazon and Azaro hand in hand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hush. It's not your turn yet.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hush. It's not your turn yet."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Damn you, Romus Toras. You are not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Damn you, Romus Toras. You are nothing but one man -- one tiny little man."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alright. That was the last straw,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alright. That was the last straw, General. Let this be a message to you both..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't waste your words, General. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't waste your words, General. It's over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your father already signed the doc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your father already signed the documents. You'd better respect the law now."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I have no choice but to respect th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no choice but to respect this decree, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I swear my undying allegiance to y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear my undying allegiance to you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus signaled to Sevrio, who took..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus signaled to Sevrio, who took hold of Taddeus' wheelchair before passing him off to his Guardians waiting at the far end of the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nodded to Titus, who signaled to..."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded to Titus, who signaled to our armed visitors.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nodded to Titus, who signaled to..."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded to Titus, who signaled to Sevrio.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without missing a beat, two Wruhec'..."
entries.dialogueText: Without missing a beat, two Wruhec's Guardians pushed Taddeus' wheelchair to the desk and pressed a pen firmly into his grip.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nodded to Titus, who signaled to..."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded to Titus, who signaled to our armed visitors.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nodded to Titus, who signaled to..."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded to Titus, who signaled to Sevrio.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""May he find redemption in the afte..."
entries.dialogueText: "May he find redemption in the afterlife."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The knife flew past me, embedding i..."
entries.dialogueText: The knife flew past me, embedding itself in the head of a wall-mounted animal above my shoulder. One of the guards pulled it out and handed it to me.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Don’t! Think of the consequences.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don’t! Think of the consequences."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Don’t! Think of the consequences.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don’t! Think of the consequences."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a moment, Lucita took a deep..."
entries.dialogueText: After a moment, Lucita took a deep breath, calming herself down.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""So it was all a lie? You gained my..."
entries.dialogueText: "So it was all a lie? You gained my trust -- my love -- just so you could destroy my family?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In a flash, her hand moved to her s..."
entries.dialogueText: In a flash, her hand moved to her side and pulled out the hidden knife she always carried. She drew her arm back.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Lucita! Preserve the family honor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita! Preserve the family honor at all costs!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Too shaken to respond, his daughter..."
entries.dialogueText: Too shaken to respond, his daughter simply stared as he was wheeled out of the room.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Carlos! Preserve the family honor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Carlos! Preserve the family honor at all costs!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His cousin looked away as he was wh..."
entries.dialogueText: His cousin looked away as he was wheeled out of the room.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""No! The Queen of Rizia will not st..."
entries.dialogueText: "No! The Queen of Rizia will not stand for such humiliation!"
